kpm1_vs_pns_mae._comment: KPM-1 had the lowest MAE in the field. Closest pollster on Labour, Lib Dem, AND Green. Close 2nd on Reform UK. Worst on Conservative (+6.5pp over-projection).

council_winners_notes.Tameside: Reform took all 14 seats Lab defended. Lab held council 50yrs. KPM-1 ✓ HIT (Reform toss-up).
council_winners_notes.Wigan: Reform took all 20 seats Lab defended. Lab held council 50+yrs. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Labour toss-up).
council_winners_notes.Newcastle-under-Lyme: REFORM'S FIRST EVER COUNCIL. Took 24 of 44 seats. Gained from Conservatives. KPM-1 ✓ HIT (Reform toss-up 4.7pp).
council_winners_notes.Sutton: LD won 51 of 55 seats — gained 23. Tories lost all 20 cllrs. KPM-1 ✓ HIT (LD toss-up 12.4pp — easy hold).
council_winners_notes.Ealing: Labour held with majority. KPM-1 ✓ HIT (Labour toss-up 6pp).
council_winners_notes.Westminster: Conservatives took from Labour. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Lab toss-up 2.1pp). PollCheck got this right.
council_winners_notes.Hartlepool: Lab loss → NOC. Reform took all 12 seats up. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Lab toss-up).
council_winners_notes.Redditch: Lab lost control. Reform won 8 of 9 seats up. NOC. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Reform toss-up).
council_winners_notes.Tamworth: Lab loss → NOC. Reform won all 9 seats up. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Reform toss-up).
council_winners_notes.North East Lincolnshire: Reform largest single party (~14 seats), Lab 11. NOC continues. KPM-1 ✗ MISS LEAN (said Reform outright).
council_winners_notes.Hart: LD 8 / CCH 7 / Con 6 / Ind 1. LD largest. NOC continues. KPM-1 ✗ MISS LEAN (said Conservative).
council_winners_notes.Southampton: Labour lost control → NOC. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Lab toss-up 3.1pp).
council_winners_notes.Havant: NOC continues. KPM-1 ✗ MISS (said Reform toss-up 3.5pp).

failure_modes.topic: Reform Labour-heartland sweep stronger than KPM-1 modelled
failure_modes.actual: Reform UK took all 20 Labour-defended seats
failure_modes.reason: Anti-Labour swing in low-engagement post-industrial wards mis-calibrated by 4-5pp. KPM-2 fix: tighter coupling between national-mood signal and incumbent-party penalty in NRS-D/E heavy wards.

failure_modes.predicted: Clean winner for Redditch (Reform), Tamworth (Reform), Hartlepool (Labour)
failure_modes.actual: All three went NOC — three-way fragmentation between Lab / Reform / Cons
failure_modes.reason: Model binarises winner from highest-share party. In 2026's three-way fragmented landscape, plurality ≠ control. KPM-2 fix: explicit no-overall-control class with margin-based confidence band.

failure_modes.topic: Lean track Hart: predicted Conservative, actual NOC with LD largest
failure_modes.actual: LD 8 / CCH 7 / Con 6 — NOC, Lib Dem largest
failure_modes.reason: Hart has been LD/CCH-leaning for years. Pre-registered Conservative call was an outlier read; included because lean-track was published as-is at 5 May refresh. Honest miss: this was the single most-overconfident lean-track call.
